errors.text_span: 三种不同模型（“Pun of The Day”、“SemEval”和“CoLBERT”）
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies all three series as 'models'. Based on the names and the reference description, 'Pun of The Day' and 'SemEval' are datasets, while ColBERT is a model.
The name of the model is spelled 'ColBERT' in the legend, but the description incorrectly capitalizes the 'L', spelling it 'CoLBERT'.
The value for ColBERT at x=3 is closer to 94.4 on the plot.
The value for ColBERT at x=4 is visibly higher than 95.8, it is approximately 95.9, just below the 96 grid line.
